mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and the unemployment rate is above 5.0%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy combined with a weak labor market, which suppresses corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery (HOUST above 1000 thousand units), new home construction activity stimulates consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) fall below 380,000 million dollars, it signals a contraction in consumer spending that reduces corporate revenues, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS < 380000.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 215.0 and the federal funds rate is below 3.0%, it indicates a lagging monetary response to inflation, which increases the risk of future rate hikes and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS < 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 137,000 thousand persons, it signals a strong labor market that supports consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS > 137000.
